name: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products [1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
LPL has developed 600+ formulations in 15 therapeutic areas and has 1700 
 registered products with another 700 in the pipeline. It also has 7 patented products and has filed applications for 25+ patents

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.0% over past five years.
Dividend payout has been low at 4.12% of profits over last 3 years
